name: Kill You In The Morning?
author: ZoeKennington
description:
A modernisation of One Thousand and One Nights by Nigel and Zoe Kennington, this game sees the player take on the role of the vizier's clever and creative daughter, who must sneak around the city in order to collect inspiration and craft a riveting tale that will convince the king to let her live another day.

Written for the 2021 Create With Code Game Jam, 'Kill You In The Morning?' fulfils the Interactivity Mashup diversifier by combining stealth and storytelling mechanics. If Scheherazade is spotted by the guards, she will lose some of the time she needs to complete her story, which is made up of multiple elements describing the characters, setting and actions taken during it.
